prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding tips and a timer to waiting screens was helpful (+8.9%, p=0.0008), closely matching predictions (+8.0%).
Redesigning or updating layouts for path choice and intro screens was helpful (+12.0% for split view redesign, +4.2% for story scroll layout).
Certain new flows and new screens were harmful, such as a post-setup launcher flow (-19.6%, p=0.001) and customization style preview screen (-9.1%, p=0.017).
Copy changes, hints, step reordering, status indicators, notification toggles, animation previews, and other redesigns showed no clear effect.
Predictions for path choice and layout improvements were too low.
Predictions for new flows, new screens, step reordering, hints, copy changes, and other redesigns were consistently too high.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +5.9% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: -7.0% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +1.4% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -2.5% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +4.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +4.6% over 2 test(s)
- finish, hint: +8.9% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: -6.4% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -2.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, redesign: +2.1% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.2% over 4 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: -0.2% over 4 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.3% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 86.5%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Centered Layout for Pet Selection Screen: Redesign the pet selection screen with a centered layout and distinct friend preview cards to make choosing a starter pet cleaner and more engaging. (why: Adoption has a steep drop-off (60.9% conversion) with high completion times (median 89s). A clean centered layout simplifies pet selection.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pre-Adoption Mascot Companion Intro Screen: Add a friendly mascot introduction screen right before photo upload to explain how photos turn into custom desktop pets. (why: Support mails report confusion with custom pet creation failing or looking wrong. Explaining the pet creation pre-requisites improves adoption conversion.)
2: [finish, redesign] Spotlight Redesign for Home Welcome Screen: Redesign the home intro screen into a spotlight layout highlighting key pet interactions and quick desktop controls. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% and users report being unclear how to control or hide their pet after onboarding.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Pet Pick Selection: Reorder onboarding so users choose their pet first on the pick_friend screen before being prompted to sign in. (why: Sign in has a 72.9% drop-off early in the process. Letting users pick a pet first builds commitment before asking for credentials.)
4: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Timer and Checklist Waiting Screen: Enhance the waiting screen with a checklist layout and live progress timer showing step-by-step pet rendering status. (why: The waiting screen (home step) has mean time of 2336s. Timer and checklist info keep users informed and engaged during generation.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Account Pet Retrieval Clarification on Sign-In: Update sign-in screen headline and body text to reassure returning users that signing in restores their existing pets. (why: Multiple support emails (8 messages) noted pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Path Choice Decision Time Hint: Add a clear hint under path choice buttons indicating that paths can be changed anytime in settings later. (why: Mean time on path choice screen is 514s despite median 8s, showing some users stall contemplating their choice.)
7: [adoption, incentive] First Pet Adoption Progress Bar Badge: Add a visual step counter and completion badge on the adoption certificate screen to celebrate finishing pet creation. (why: Adoption step has the biggest drop-off (60.9% conversion). Rewarding progress encourages users to complete certificate creation.)

scores.note: Adoption has high drop-off (60.9%) and long duration; layout redesigns for path/intro screens have strong positive precedent.
Although evidence from support emails exists, introducing new screens in onboarding consistently caused negative drop-offs in tests.
Finish step drop-off is noticeable and layout redesigns generally perform well, though impact is moderate.
Reordering steps has shown near-zero measurable effect in historical data.
Adding timers/progress info to long waiting screens has strong proven success (+8.9%) and directly addresses the high mean generation time.
Clear evidence in support tickets, but copy changes historically show no significant conversion lift.
Mean time is high, but adding hints to path choice previously resulted in a negative lift (-2.5%).
Targets high-drop step, but status/badge elements historically yield minor or ambiguous results.
